fusions.name: Headsman's Mandate
fusions.desc: A sentencing chop on an enemy at or below 30% health that deals 26 damage and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Raised and Brought Down
fusions.desc: Raises the blade high and brings it down, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Arms at the Ready
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more Power while it holds.

fusions.name: Decreed to Land
fusions.desc: Once every 8 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
